issue.title: Two bead-store tests assert the absent-store branch but let the resolver find the host's live store, so both fail on any machine with beads
issue.description:
Two tests that assert "no bead store" behavior pass only on a host with no real bead
store. Both neutralize one input to store resolution and leave the resolver itself free
to find the machine's live store, so they fail deterministically in any normal agent
workspace on athena.

REPRODUCED 2026-09-20 at master 19c515e0ae by the sase-14d land agent, in isolation
(`uv run pytest <both nodes> -q` -> 2 failed in 2.93s), and again as part of the
sase-14d.5 phase run at 0f5a81da70. Not selected by `just test-scoped`, so `just check`
stays green; they surface in the full lane and in any direct run.

ROOT CAUSE (both are the same shape, in two different resolvers):

1. `tests/doctor/test_checks_beads.py::test_project_beads_skips_when_store_is_absent`
   patches `sase.doctor.checks_beads.resolve_current_project_record` to `None` and then
   asserts `_check_project_beads(...)` returns SKIP. But the SKIP branch is gated on
   `_find_existing_beads_dir(context)` (src/sase/doctor/checks_beads.py:194), which
   still walks its other candidate paths and finds the host store, so the check runs for
   real and returns `OK`.
   Failure: `AssertionError: assert 'OK' == 'SKIP'`.

2. `tests/completion/test_candidates_project_providers.py::test_bead_candidates_without_a_store_returns_empty_list`
   only does `monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)` and asserts
   `candidates_for("bead", "", project=None, limit=200) == []`. `bead_candidates`
   (src/sase/completion/candidates/catalog_sdd.py:45) returns `[]` only when
   `_resolve_beads_dir()` is `None`; that resolver is not cwd-bound, so it finds the
   live store and the call returns real bead ids.
   Failure: `assert [Candidate(value='bryan-1', description='Epic'), ...] == []`
   (17 candidates).

SUGGESTED FIX: isolate the resolver rather than one of its inputs - point each test's
store resolution at an empty `tmp_path` (or patch `_find_existing_beads_dir` /
`_resolve_beads_dir` to return `None`) so the absent-store branch is what is actually
exercised. This is the same family as the already-fixed sase-ql (doctor tests reading
live plugin entry points) and sase-ml (tests reading the live ~/.sase/procs runtime
tree); neither of those covers bead-store resolution.

PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-14d.5 (epic sase-14d, "sase notify rules, doctor check, and
docs") as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note; triaged and reproduced by the sase-14d land agent.
Unrelated to that epic's notification-delivery work.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic, not intermittent: both nodes fail on every run, in isolation and in the full lane, on any host that has a real bead store, and both pass on a host without one. The failures are assertion mismatches against live store contents (doctor returns OK instead of SKIP; the completion provider returns 17 real bead ids instead of []), not timing or ordering. Reproduced at 19c515e0ae and earlier at 0f5a81da70.
